adds.title: The Defenders#5

owner_calls.title: The Defenders
owner_calls.question: Jessica and Karen are both at the precinct with the group (Fish in the Jailhouse, The Defenders), and their only stage (Born Again S2#1) says Jessica 'reconnects' with Karen, implying they met there, but no exchange between them is recorded. Add a Defenders stage for that first meeting?
options: Add an ally stage at The Defenders#7 for their time at the precinct with Matt
owner_calls.evidence: Karen Page page lists her talking with Matt, Foggy and Trish at the precinct, none with Jessica.
